name: breach-radar-mcp
description: Passive, public-data security checks: Have I Been Pwned breach lookups (email lookups only when the server operator has set an HIBP key), k-anonymous password checks, NIST CVE search, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, and a domain's public attack surface (security headers, TLS, SPF/DMARC/DNSSEC/CAA, certificate-transparency subdomains). No scanning or probing.
